name: sl-repo
description: SL (Steam Locomotive) runs across your terminal when you type "sl" as you meant to type "ls". It's just a joke command.
author: Mike Wallio

scripts.build:websl: bun run check:wasm-pack && wasm-pack build libraries/websl --target web --release --no-pack
scripts.build:websl:rust: bun run check:wasm-pack && wasm-pack build libraries/websl --target web --release --no-pack
scripts.start: bun run build && bun run start:page
scripts.test: bun run test:websl && bun run test:page
scripts.test:websl: bun run check:wasm-pack && wasm-pack test --headless --firefox libraries/websl
scripts.test:websl:rust: bun run check:wasm-pack && wasm-pack test --headless --firefox libraries/websl
